text:
```yaml
name: Stale Issues

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Midnight UTC, daily
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Mark and close stale issues
        uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          daysUntilStale: 180
          daysUntilClose: 0
          staleLabel: stale
          staleMessage: |
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has been open for 6 months with no activity. It will be closed immediately. If you believe this issue is still relevant, please reopen it or create a new issue. Thank you for your contributions.
          closeMessage: |
            This issue has been automatically closed because it has been marked as stale for 6 months with no activity. If you believe this issue is still relevant, please reopen it or create a new issue. Thank you for your contributions.
          exemptLabels: pinned,security,working in progress,to be discussed,feature request
          operationsPerRun: 30
          onlyIssues: true
```
